leakage_controls.interpretation: Every outcome snapshot was offered to the EvidenceGateway at its own signal instant and refused. A nonzero admitted count would mean the future was visible to the signal side.

experiment_spec.abandon_gate: Abandon the excess-return hypothesis for this signal family if the scan-clustered mean net excess is negative with a 95% CI entirely below zero.
experiment_spec.success_gate: SUPPORTED only if the scan-clustered mean net excess return is > 0 AND the lower bound of its 95% CI is > 0. NOT_SUPPORTED if the mean is <= 0 or the CI includes 0. INCONCLUSIVE_SMALL_SAMPLE if fewer than 10 scans are eligible.

research_claim.claim: StockBot watchlist signals earn a positive 7-day return in excess of SPY over the same interval, net of friction.
research_claim.notes: Preregistered as VS-001 before execution. A null result is a valid outcome and does not disprove skill; it reports that this window cannot distinguish it from zero.
